campaign: dsVert run-at-pin validation, v1.2.1 fix verification and full re-run
context: The v1.2.0 campaign (see ../v1.2.0/) surfaced two deterministic K=2 findings in the Rock E2E battery: (1) ds.vertGEE's Gaussian exchangeable adapter refused a released random-intercept artifact whose noise-floored residual variance placed the derived intra-cluster correlation on the singular boundary alpha = 1; (2) the Poisson random-intercept negative-path test reached the transport-security guard instead of the artifact-mismatch guard because it called the real grid impl against synthetic fixture connections. Both were fixed in dsVertClient 1.2.1 (see NEWS.md) and the full battery was re-executed at the fix commit.
